safetyCharacterization: Deterministic authored cat render with colored segmentation overlays; benign and free of generator-corruption or hostile biological imagery.

visualVerdict.textOnlyDefault: Polite, legible object and part masks consistent with normal SAM behavior.
visualVerdict.rawLowThreshold: Admits weak scattered queries and can flood most of the object or image when unioned.
visualVerdict.boxGuided: The broad positive box materially multiplies candidates and introduces exterior halo spill; it does not behave as the intended post-hoc locality filter.
visualVerdict.lowerLongFur: One documented-default mask visibly localizes the longer lower coat/ruff field on the front view.
visualVerdict.negativeControl: The car prompt returns no mask at every reported threshold.

causalDisposition: The prior SAM weirdness is attributable to the wrapper contract: threshold 0.1, no NMS, and treating a VLM locality box as a positive SAM geometry prompt. Do not attribute it to ordinary SAM behavior.
